PNC gives No. 2 exec a $20M award, board seat
summary: The moves may cement Mark Wiedman as a potential successor to CEO Bill Demchak and lend continuity to a bank that, while growing, has seen changes in two high-profile C-suite slots in 18 months.
content: PNC has awarded its No. 2 executive, Mark Wiedman, a $20 million award and a board seat. These moves could position him as a potential successor to CEO Bill Demchak, while bringing leadership continuity to the growing bank following recent executive changes in its C-suite over the past 18 months.

summary: Are Ripple’s XRP, Cardano (ADA), and Polygon (POL) losing their appeal among crypto investors in 2026? Simpson cited concerns regarding weak network activity, questionable valuations, and rising competition, suggesting these major digital assets are losing their appeal among certain investors.

title: FM Summit London 2026 Brings Financial Services Leaders Together for a Day of Insights, Connections and Industry-Shaping Discussions
summary:
FM Summit London 2026 brought together the financial services industry at Old Billingsgate, London, for its 15th edition, creating a meeting point for senior decision-makers, industry leaders, financial institutions, brokers and technology providers.
With a programme focused on the developments transforming financial services, the summit combined high-level discussions, expert perspectives and valuable face-to-face connections.
Throughout the summit day, the venue was filled with conversations, networking and business meetings, reflecting the continued importance of uniting the financial services community for direct, in-person connection.
The summit experience began ahead of the main event, with the Opening Networking Blitz at The Folly on 23 November, giving attendees an opportunity to reconnect with familiar faces and make new introductions before the main summit.
Conversations that matter: From financial services to digital assets
The conference programme provided a platform for some of the industry's most thought-provoking conversations, bringing different perspectives to the stage and encouraging attendees to look beyond current market developments.
The summit opened with a conversation on AI, “AI & Trading 2027: From Copilots to Colleagues”, an intriguing panel discussion featuring Steven J. Hatzakis, Global Director of Research at ForexBrokers.com, Yangling Li, Head Quant at BestX, Andrew Ralich, CEO & Co-Founder at oneZero, Jon Light, Senior Director of Product at Devexperts, Hugh Whelan, President of ACI UK, Financial Markets Association, and Christoforos Theodoulou, Chief Business Officer at MetaQuotes. The panelists took a deep dive into the applicability of AI in trading, data quality, models, controls, and beyond.
Later in the day, Lord Peter Cruddas took a trip down memory lane when he founded CMC Markets, offering valuable insights into leadership and the brokerage firm’s longevity as CMC Markets turned 40. His perspective was captured in the CMC anniversary discussion titled “CMC at 35: Lord Peter Cruddas in Conversation,” a statement of brokerage leadership from tradition to the AI era.
Next, “Part of The Landscape? Digital Assets & TradFi Liquidity” brought to the stage Ian Daniels, COO & Global Head at eFX, Chris Knight, Managing Director at LMAX Digital, Waqar Chodri, Managing Director, Global Head, Digital Assets at Standard Chartered Bank, Katryna Hanush, Managing Director, Business Development & Partnerships at Wintermute, and David Brickell, Head of Distribution at FRNT Financial, to examine the evolving relationship between traditional finance and digital assets. The discussion addressed the changing liquidity landscape and the implications for institutional markets and financial infrastructure.
The programme also welcomed Lord Kulveer Ranger for “From Westminster to the Boardroom: In Conversation With Lord Kulveer Ranger.” In conversation with Duska Nedeljkovic, Head of Conferences at Ultimate Group, Lord Ranger brought a perspective shaped by his experience in Westminster and business leadership, exploring the relationship between public policy, government and commercial decision-making.
These discussions reflected the summit's commitment to bringing relevant voices and perspectives together, addressing not only where the industry stands today but also the opportunities and challenges ahead.
Bringing the industry together
Beyond the conference stages, the exhibition floor provided opportunities for companies to showcase their solutions, strengthen existing relationships and establish new business connections.
Leading companies, including LMAX Group, Plus500, oneZero, PLUGIT, Adaptive, Edge Hound, AEGIS Trading Technology, MetaQuotes, Devexperts, Acuity and CXM Prime, were among the participating brands.
Business Connect Roundtables and One-to-One meetings further supported meaningful conversations in a different format and enabled connections between professionals around shared business interests and industry priorities.
15 editions of bringing the industry together
Returning to Old Billingsgate for its 15th edition gave FM Summit London 2026 particular significance. The venue, closely associated with the event's legacy, provided the setting for another chapter in its ongoing journey of connecting the global financial services community.
The success of this edition reflects the importance of creating spaces where industry professionals can exchange ideas, build relationships and explore new opportunities.
FM Summits would like to thank all attendees, speakers, sponsors, exhibitors, partners and supporting media for being part of FM Summit London 2026 and contributing to another memorable edition.
As the industry continues to evolve, the conversations started in London will continue well beyond the summit itself.
One Day. One Venue. One Industry.
 
NoYesInfrastructure24 Nov, 2026
content: The FM Summit London 2026 successfully brought together financial services leaders, brokers, and technology providers at Old Billingsgate for its 15th edition. The event featured high-level discussions on artificial intelligence in trading, leadership insights from CMC Markets, digital assets, and public policy intersections. Industry stakeholders gathered for networking, roundtables, and exhibitions, reinforcing the importance of direct in-person collaboration for the global financial community.
content_ta: FM Summit London 2026 மாநாடு லண்டனில் உள்ள Old Billingsgate-ல் தனது 15-வது பதிப்பாக நிதி சேவைகள் துறை தலைவர்கள், புரோக்கர்கள் மற்றும் தொழில்நுட்ப வழங்குநர்களை வெற்றிகரமாக ஒன்றிணைத்தது. வர்த்தகத்தில் செயற்கை நுண்ணறிவு, CMC Markets நிறுவனத்தின் தலைமைத்துவ நுண்ணறிவுகள், டிஜிட்டல் சொத்துக்கள் மற்றும் பொதுக் கொள்கை குறித்த உயர்மட்ட விவாதங்கள் இந்நிகழ்ச்சியில் இடம்பெற்றன. உலகளாவிய நிதி சமூகத்திற்கு நேரடி ஒத்துழைப்பின் முக்கியத்துவத்தை வலியுறுத்தும் வகையில் நெட்வொர்க்கிங் மற்றும் கண்காட்சிகள் நடைபெற்றன.
